opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three, up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in a UK university, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date, and must meet UK residence/degree or UK academic position requirements.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to enable early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other higher‑education institutions (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes) may apply. Applicants must be employed by the eligible institution and act as principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative and original research projects up to five years, covering staff costs and associated research expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: A UK university staff member (or specialist arts institution) must act as host applicant; the visiting professor must be an eminent overseas scholar.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK institutions to invite an eminent overseas professor for a 3‑12 month visit to enhance skills and knowledge in an under‑represented research area.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent), at least two years post‑PhD experience, and who have not previously led a research team or held large project funding.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a modest research team and demonstrate research leadership over 4‑5 years.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (single or collaborative centres) may apply; previously excluded institutions are now eligible.
opportunities.summary: Large‑scale research centres aiming for step‑change in scholarship, funded for up to ten years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in the humanities or social sciences employed by a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships to enable senior scholars to complete a major piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering fine and performing arts training to school‑age children (under 18).
opportunities.summary: Funding for specialist arts institutions to provide training opportunities (weekends, evenings, holidays) for school‑age children.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Undergraduate & Postgraduate

amount.raw: Bursaries £5,000 to £10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities (not university departments) may award bursaries to outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate students in need.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support undergraduate and postgraduate students in fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who live in the UK, have a record of research, and meet UK residence and previous UK university affiliation requirements.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired scholars to complete or integrate a research project, with awards of 3‑24 months.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million total (covering up to 30 doctoral scholarships and related costs)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply for doctoral scholarships and associated post‑doctoral opportunities.
opportunities.summary: Centenary Doctoral Scholarships to fund up to 30 doctoral students (including under‑represented groups) and related post‑doctoral and programme costs over a 9‑year award.
